title: Choosing values with conditions
description: You can follow an if expression and a Boolean condition in Mini.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You bind age to the supplied value. The next expression can use that value in a comparison.

steps.question: Which value will the if expression assign to status?
steps.answer: It assigns the string adult because age meets the comparison's threshold.

steps.description: The chosen branch supplies the value assigned to status. You then print adult.
not false evaluates to true, so the and condition succeeds. You see the second print's logic message after adult in the supplied output.
